quality_rules: Organize related source-backed information into separate, scanable technical topics.
Retain symptoms, limitations, commands, references, direct guidance, and explicitly unresolved gaps when they are present in the input.
Do not turn a question, suggestion, or field guidance into confirmed product documentation or a required action.
Do not emit unsupported facts, stale states, social chatter, or source identifiers in the reader-facing digest.
Use only source-verbatim evidence for reader-facing bullets; source references remain an internal validation artifact.
